source.snippet: We onboarded a new customer and inherited an on-premises active directory domain with some obsolete stuff going on... domain still uses NTFRS for SYSVOL / NETLOGON replication. As a first step in onboarding their environment, I want to migrate NTFRS to DFSR, upgrade the forest / domain functional level to 2016...

problem_statement: IT managed service providers regularly inherit legacy Windows Server environments still running deprecated NTFRS replication, requiring time-consuming manual migration procedures to DFSR before they can safely modernize the domain — a recurring onboarding cost with no automated tooling.
target_segment: IT managed service providers (MSPs) and sysadmins onboarding SMB clients with legacy Windows Server / Active Directory environments
notes: Buyer context: MSP billing clients for onboarding hours; legacy AD remediation is a known recurring cost. A scripted/automated NTFRS-to-DFSR migration tool or managed assessment service could save MSPs hours per client engagement. Single data point — needs corroboration from MSP forums or Reddit r/msp.
